page_title: COM 1-1 PAR | Como v Parma 19/10/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's the end of the match.
90+4' The Como players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
90+1' Luca Mazzitelli (Como) hammers the ball from far out, but it goes narrowly over the bar.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
90' There's a melee in the box, but the referee isn't interested in the appeals from Parma for a penalty. Play continues.
87' Parma quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.

86' Gabriel Charpentier (Parma) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and smashes a glorious looking effort towards the roof of the net, but Emil Audero thwarts him with a great two-handed save.
85' Substitution. Sergi Roberto is replaced by Alessandro Gabrielloni (Como).
85' The substitution has been made. Edoardo Goldaniga (Como) has replaced Alberto Dossena.
81' Ball possession – 61:39.
78' Fabio Pecchia has decided to make a change. Drissa Camara (Parma) replaces Hernani.
77' Hernani (Parma) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
77' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Lucas Da Cunha (Como) replaces Alieu Fadera.
76' A mid-range free kick is awarded to Parma.
74' Hernani (Parma) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
71' Fabio Pecchia has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Mandela Keita (Parma) replacing Simon Sohm.
71' Here comes a substitution. Gabriel Charpentier (Parma) is brought on as a substitute for Ange-Yoan Bonny.
70' The ball is cleared after Adrian Bernabe Garcia (Parma) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
68' Nico Paz (Como) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.
68' Nico Paz (Como) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.
67' Valentin Mihaila (Parma) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
66' Parma have a corner.
66' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Parma.
63' It is time for a substitution. Luca Mazzitelli (Como) is on for Gabriel Strefezza.
63' Here is a change. Alberto Moreno is going off and Cesc Fabregas gives the last tactical orders to Marco Sala (Como).
62' Valentin Mihaila (Parma) expertly controls a neat clever pass on the edge of the penalty area, but his effort smashes against the right post! What a shot that was!
59' Sergi Roberto (Como) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
59' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Nico Paz (Como) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
56' Fabio Pecchia prepares a substitution. Pontus Almqvist is replaced by Valentin Mihaila (Parma).
56' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Matteo Cancellieri walks off the pitch to be replaced by Dennis Man (Parma).
54' A brilliant individual effort! Patrick Cutrone (Como) tricks his way past challenges into the box and blazes his shot just a few inches over the top.
53' The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Como.
52' Nico Paz (Como) takes a short corner kick.
49' An attempted cross from Gabriel Strefezza (Como) is cleared.
49' Gabriel Strefezza (Como) attempts to find one of his teammates with a fine lofted pass, but the defence reacts well to intercept the effort.
46' Michael Fabbri blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+2' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45' 1 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' 1 - 1 Fantastic team goal! Nico Paz (Como) was set free in the area by Alieu Fadera and made no mistake with a lovely finish into the bottom right corner. 1:1.
42' OFF THE BAR! Adrian Bernabe Garcia (Parma) strikes a brilliant shot towards goal from the free kick, but his effort rattles the crossbar.
41' The linesman signals that Alieu Fadera (Como) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
40' The number of shots on goal at present is 1:2.
36' Parma are awarded a mid-range free kick.

32' Patrick Cutrone (Como) looks very eager to impress, does well to beat his man and force a cross into the box, where one of his teammates gets his head on the ball, but it's too easy for the keeper.
31' Simon Sohm (Parma) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.

31' That didn't go as planned! Antoine Hainaut (Parma) tried his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort towards the bottom right corner was too weak to get past Emil Audero, who easily kept it out.
28' Alberto Dossena (Como) outbattles the defender to win the ball from the corner, but he can't quite control his header and sends it just over the bar.
28' Como force a corner. They send men into the box.
27' Neat passing move from Como in order to create new attacking opportunities.
25' Como have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
22' Alieu Fadera (Como) gets on the end of a defence splitting pass inside the box and immediately directs a low shot towards the middle of the goal, but the Zion Suzuki makes a great save.
20' 0 - 1 GOAL! Ange-Yoan Bonny (Parma) finishes off a sublime move with a delightful back-heel goal. Hernani provided the assist with a brilliant pass. 0:1.
17' Alberto Moreno (Como) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.
16' Adrian Bernabe Garcia (Parma) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.
14' Nico Paz (Como) slips past one challenge, but is unable to feed a low pass into the path of one of his teammates.
11' Ange-Yoan Bonny (Parma) shows too much aggression while trying to break free from his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
9' Gabriel Strefezza (Como) hammers the ball towards the roof of the net, but it's not so easy to put it beyond Zion Suzuki, who denies him with a terrific save.
9' Alieu Fadera (Como) clips an inviting cross into the box, but there's no one in a position to get on the end of it.
7' Como enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
4' Simon Sohm (Parma) finds space on the edge of the box, but his wild shot goes high over the bar.
3' Matteo Cancellieri (Parma) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are out at last! Como will take the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Michael Fabbri.
